lessons.concept: Discover need, context, budget, timing, and criteria; recommend only a suitable solution and accept that no purchase may be the right outcome. A sound decision always connects the customer need, the visual or commercial rule, its implementation in the site, and an observable signal. This prevents vague preferences and copied tactics whose purpose is not understood.

explanation.title: Simple analogy
explanation.text: Ethical sales process and qualification is like arranging a physical shop: every color, space, message, or offer should help a visitor understand where they are, what they can buy, and why they can trust the next step.

explanation.title: Understand it deeply
explanation.text: Discover need, context, budget, timing, and criteria; recommend only a suitable solution and accept that no purchase may be the right outcome. Name the precise problem before selecting a tool. Observe context, device, intent, and customer objections. Then write a hypothesis that links one change to an expected result without presenting that hypothesis as established fact.
